note: Failure-mode detectors for marketing analytics components. 'kind' decides the tool: lint (model_lint.py, deterministic), dax (probes.py with a dax.* method), stat (probes.py with a stat.* method from stats_lib.py). 'applies_when' lists the signals the agent should recognise during investigation. Methods are documented in METHODS.md; add a detector by adding an entry here, a section there and, if needed, a function in stats_lib.py.

applies_when: calculated column uses TODAY()/NOW()
flags such as is_current_month / completed month / last N days
detectors.claim: Date flags derived from the clock reflect the imported data's completeness, not the machine date.

applies_when: measure uses TODAY()/NOW()
MTD / YTD / projection / pacing measures
detectors.claim: Clock-dependent measures are documented as such and behave correctly on a stale import.

applies_when: ALL/ALLSELECTED/REMOVEFILTERS on the date table inside a measure
monthly costs or targets shown under a date slicer
detectors.claim: Removing the date context is intended and a partial-period selection does not add whole-period amounts.

applies_when: ratio measure written with / instead of DIVIDE
detectors.claim: Ratios return BLANK, not infinity or an error, on empty denominators.

applies_when: median / percentile / average / ratio with an integer format string
detectors.claim: Displayed precision does not hide changes the analyst cares about.

applies_when: first-touch and last-touch keys to the same dimension
inactive relationships
USERELATIONSHIP in measures
detectors.claim: Each visual's attribution lens (first / last touch) matches its label.

applies_when: 'Last refresh' / 'updated' text or measure bound to MAX of a business date
detectors.claim: Freshness labels report model refresh, not the latest selected business date.

applies_when: visual projection name differs from the bound measure name
headers or legends that read differently from the measure
detectors.claim: Column headers and legends name the measure that is actually bound.

applies_when: fact joined to a dimension or bridge
counts or sums that could double through a many-to-many path
duplicate business keys
detectors.claim: Row counts and sums are unchanged by the relationship path, and business keys are unique at the declared grain.

applies_when: a breakdown by member next to a total
BLANK members possibly dropped
many-to-many or bidirectional filters
detectors.claim: Members of a breakdown sum to the displayed total for additive measures.

applies_when: any expectation expressible as a single DAX value: outside-window events, orphan keys, negative durations, future dates, zero-denominator days, timezone day mismatches
detectors.claim: The stated invariant holds in the imported population.

applies_when: CPA / CPL / ROAS / conversion rate shown per member and in total
averages of ratios in a table total or card
detectors.claim: Totals of ratio measures are ratios of totals, not averages of member ratios.

applies_when: a daily ratio of two differently sourced populations (CRM vs platform, spend vs conversions)
shares that must stay within [0,1]
detectors.claim: The daily ratio stays within its historical band and hard bounds, except on explained days.

applies_when: a daily series with weekly seasonality (leads, sessions, spend)
a single-day spike or drop visible on a chart
detectors.claim: Daily values sit within the weekday-adjusted band; flagged days are explained from the source.

applies_when: a daily series over several weeks
suspected tracking break, campaign launch or attribution change
detectors.claim: Level shifts in the series correspond to known business or tracking events.

applies_when: channel / campaign / province mix compared between two periods
new or vanished categories
renamed campaigns
detectors.claim: The category mix shift between periods is explained; no category appears or disappears silently.

applies_when: campaign dimension with start_date / end_date
events (leads, spend, contracts) keyed by campaign and date
detectors.claim: No events are attributed to a campaign outside its active window, and every campaign with events has dates.
detectors.template: EVALUATE ROW("Outside", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(<fact>), FILTER(<fact>, NOT ISBLANK(RELATED(dim_campaign[start_date])) && (<fact>[<date_key>] < RELATED(dim_campaign[start_date]) || <fact>[<date_key>] > RELATED(dim_campaign[end_date])))), "UndatedCampaignEvents", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(<fact>), FILTER(<fact>, NOT ISBLANK(<fact>[campaign_key]) && ISBLANK(RELATED(dim_campaign[start_date])))))

applies_when: campaign names carried on facts as well as on the dimension
several source systems for one campaign key
detectors.claim: One campaign key has one name across the dimension and the facts that carry names.

applies_when: a fact has both a timestamp and a date key
source in one timezone, report in another
detectors.claim: The date key of every event equals the calendar date of its timestamp in the reporting timezone.
detectors.template: EVALUATE ROW("Mismatched", COUNTROWS(FILTER(<fact>, NOT ISBLANK(<fact>[<timestamp>]) && INT(<fact>[<timestamp>]) <> INT(<fact>[<date_key>]))))

applies_when: durations such as days to contract / lead to enrollment
dates after the import watermark
detectors.claim: Durations are non-negative and no event is dated after the import watermark unless it is a scheduled future event by design.
